description: Crawl a website into clean Markdown: follows same-site links from a start page (optionally under a path prefix), up to 100 pages, respecting robots.txt. Returns each page's URL, title and text. $0.005 + $0.001 per page. Add store=true (+$0.001) to get a 7-day share link instead of the data inline. Costs $0.025 USDC per call (x402).

path_prefix.description: Only follow links under this path, e.g. /docs/
